translations.web: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
translations.bsb: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.
translations.kjv: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
